claims.text: The proposed model is compared to existing MRC systems that extract answers by finding sub-strings in passages.
The proposed model outperforms the R.M.-Reader + Verifier model by 0.7 in F1 score.
The proposed model is an extension of the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN), a state-of-the-art MRC model.
